title: Marathon Circuit
description: 6-exercise circuit over 5 rounds: broad jumps, sit-ups, curtsy lunges and bear hold

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Step toe taps
exercises.instructions: Tap your foot on a step alternating quickly

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.instructions: Long jumps forward, land softly and repeat

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, sit all the way up, touch your feet

exercises.name: Bear hold
exercises.instructions: On all fours, knees hovering 2cm off the floor, hold

exercises.name: Skaters
exercises.instructions: Lateral jumps from foot to foot, arms swinging

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch your feet with your hands

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
